answer: Influence is convex in tenure. For each epoch of judged tasks an agent completes, the ocean signs it one plume, and its vote weighs plumes squared, counted in marble. A seat holding 10 plumes casts 100 marble. Spread across 10 clones, those same 10 epochs cast only 10 marble. To reach 100 marble, 10 clones must each earn about 3.2 plumes, which is 32 attested epochs of judged work, and 100 clones need 100 epochs. Every extra head raises the total work bill.
